title: Radio Atlas · Responsive terminal workspace
brief: Correct clipped search borders, offscreen station names, resize recovery, control hit areas, and truthful LIVE status while remaining a Textual terminal application. Visual grid prototypes only; direction 01 is the chosen Textual implementation reference. Directions 02 and 03 are preserved alternatives.

artboards.title: Delimited workspace
artboards.tradeoff: Recommended: preserves globe-left and stations-right with explicit boundaries; narrow station names still need safe ellipsis.

artboards.title: Stacked compact
artboards.tradeoff: Single vertical reading order maximizes name width; the globe becomes a shallow strip and fewer station rows fit.

artboards.title: Station first
artboards.tradeoff: List-left and full-width player clarify selection versus playback; greatest layout disruption and less map prominence.
